# PhysicsUpdate 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsUpdate:Void delta_time:Float32=0, world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delta_time` | In | Float32 | `0` | The time since the last call in seconds. 0 (default) measures it. Pass a constant, e.g. `1.0 / 60`, for runs that are the same every time. |
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Moves the bodies of a world forward in time. Nothing moves until this is called, `UpdateWorld` does not step physics.

Before the step, a body whose entity the program moved (`PositionEntity`, `RotateEntity`, a new parent, ...) is put where its entity is. After it, every awake dynamic body is where the simulation left it, which is also what `EntityX`, `EntityY` and `EntityZ` say.

How the time is spent depends on `PhysicsMode`. With fixed steps (the default) the time is added to what is left of the last call and the world takes as many steps of 1 / `PhysicsRate` seconds as fit, at most `PhysicsMaxSteps`; time that does not fit is dropped. `RenderWorld` then draws the bodies between the last two steps, so they move smoothly at any frame rate. With frame steps the world takes one step of exactly the time given (at most `PhysicsMaxDelta`), and nothing is interpolated.

A force given by `PhysicsApplyForce` acts in every step of the next call, an impulse acts once.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 640, 480, 32, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 3, -12
light = CreateLight()

floor = CreatePhysicsBody(1, 1, 20, 0.5, 20)
PositionEntity floor, 0, -0.5, 0
crate = CreatePhysicsBody(1, 3, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
PositionEntity crate, 0, 5, 0

While Not KeyHit(1)
	PhysicsUpdate
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```
